ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $D$ is the midpoint of $AC$, $CB = 4\,cm$, $DB = 7\,cm$, what is the length of $AB$ in $cm$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: Since $DC=DB-CB=7-4=3\,cm$,\\
and since point D is the midpoint of AC,\\
it follows that $AD=DC=3\,cm$\\
Therefore, $AB=AD+DB = 3+7=\boxed{10}\,cm$
